# Among The Letters

> A free daily reading newsletter for anyone who loves to read. Free stories, poems, and essays worth your afternoon, picked and checked daily, with a different genre each day.

Among The Letters is an independent Substack publication (est. 2026). Its main edition, Afternoon Discoveries, arrives every day with stories, poems, essays, books, and authors worth finding, most of them free to read online, and every link is checked. Each day of the week has its own genre, from literary fiction and poetry to science fiction, mystery, romance, nonfiction, and experimental writing. Paid subscribers also receive a Sunday evening Weekly Discoveries Roundup. For readers who also write, Monday Morning Opportunities, free writer resources, and two paid PDF guides are secondary extras.

## Pages

- [Home](https://amongtheletters.com/): What Among The Letters is, the daily genre week, editions, and subscriptions
- [Archive](https://amongtheletters.com/archive/): Past Afternoon Discoveries editions as PDFs, one per day, each labelled with its date and genre
- [Substack](https://amongtheletters.substack.com/): Read and subscribe free or paid; billing is handled by Substack
- [RSS feed](https://amongtheletters.substack.com/feed): New posts from the Substack publication
- [Free Resources](https://amongtheletters.com/resources/): For readers who write: a printable submission tracker, a cover letter template (PDF and Word), and a Before You Hit Submit checklist, no sign-up
- [Glossary for Writers](https://amongtheletters.com/resources/glossary/): A plain-language glossary of 70 submission, rights, contest, and form terms
- [Shop](https://amongtheletters.com/shop/): Two practical PDF guides for readers who write, sold through Payhip in Canadian dollars
- [Full description for LLMs](https://amongtheletters.com/llms-full.txt): A thorough plain-language summary of Among The Letters
- [Contact](mailto:amongtheletters@gmail.com): amongtheletters@gmail.com
